records.name: Elsa Ersteraufschlag
records.biography_en: She serves certainty at a speed the committee has not approved. She serves approved certainties across the residents' association and expects every return to count as disagreement. The wooden racquet has excellent manners and very little patience. A dissonant card has persuaded her to offer a second serve before issuing a judgement. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der erste Aufschlag gilt. Einwände dürfen zurückgespielt werden.

variant_notes.note_en: She serves certainty at a speed the committee has not approved.

records.name: Gustav Grundlinie
records.biography_en: He remains at the baseline because all change should come to him. He holds the baseline of every courtyard debate and classifies movement as concession. His racquet is worn from defending positions nobody was attacking. One ambiguous card has made him wonder whether standing firm and standing alone are related faults. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er bleibt seiner Linie treu. Der Rest des Platzes wurde informiert.

variant_notes.note_en: He remains at the baseline because all change should come to him.

records.name: Nelly Netzgewinn
records.biography_en: She is excellent at doubles until somebody asks whose turn it is. She plays doubles by checking whether her partner is comfortable, then apologises for checking. The folded net represents the association's comforting division into our side and theirs. She increasingly suspects that both sides would enjoy a drink together. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie deckt die Mitte. Wer dazugehört, bleibt offen.

variant_notes.note_en: She is excellent at doubles until somebody asks whose turn it is.

records.name: Viktor Rückhand
records.biography_en: He returns criticism with interest and a pleasing amount of spin. He returns every remark with the sort of spin that makes a simple apology travel sideways. The building rewards him for winning arguments rather than games. A dissonant card about letting a point go has proved infuriatingly hard to return. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er gibt nichts zurück. Außer mit Wirkung.

variant_notes.note_en: He returns criticism with interest and a pleasing amount of spin.

records.name: Bodo Ballwechsel
records.biography_en: He believes every rally can be settled by keeping one more ball in reserve. He keeps three spare balls because the association calls every interruption a personal failure. The tin is easier to manage than his supply of reassurance. He has begun offering a pause to exhausted neighbours before offering them another chance to perform. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Drei Bälle sind vorrätig. Die Ruhe wird nachgeliefert.

variant_notes.note_en: He believes every rally can be settled by keeping one more ball in reserve.

records.name: Sir Satzverlust
records.biography_en: He loses with such formality that victory feels insufficiently dressed. He treats every lost set as a defect in the etiquette of winning. The sagging racquet strings retain a posture of institutional dignity. A card describing defeat as company rather than disgrace has finally given him someone to sit beside afterwards. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Niederlage war unpassend gekleidet. Er hat Beschwerde eingelegt.

variant_notes.note_en: He loses with such formality that victory feels insufficiently dressed.
